import pathlib, json, os
p=pathlib.Path('/inputs/codec.py')
print('exists',p.exists(),'size',p.stat().st_size)
print(p.read_text())

import json
from importlib.machinery import SourceFileLoader

codec = SourceFileLoader('codec','/inputs/codec.py').load_module()

x = 'a a'
once = codec.canonicalize_url(x)
twice = codec.canonicalize_url(once)
print('input:',repr(x))
print('once :',repr(once))
print('twice:',repr(twice))
print('counterexample?', once != twice)

obj = {'input': x, 'once': once, 'twice': twice}
with open('/work/counterexample.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(obj,f,ensure_ascii=False)

print('written:', open('/work/counterexample.json','r',encoding='utf-8').read())
